metrics.label: Monthly recurring revenue
metrics.description: Rolling MRR computed from Stripe subscriptions.

metrics.description: Sum of successful checkout sessions in the current day.
metrics.whatIsNeeded: LPBS /api/v1/admin/dashboard/revenue endpoint with a daily-rollup query.

metrics.description: Every app the control plane knows about, running or not.

metrics.label: Degraded apps

metrics.label: Active subscribers

metrics.label: Revenue · 30 days
metrics.description: Revenue from successful checkout sessions in the trailing thirty days.
metrics.whatIsNeeded: LPBS /api/v1/admin/dashboard/revenue endpoint with a configurable window.

metrics.label: Default-alive posture
metrics.description: Money Ledger cash, burn, revenue, runway, goal verdicts and default-alive gap surfaced through Offer Desk.
metrics.whatIsNeeded: Offer Desk board response with a live Money Ledger position and producer observation time.

sample.basis: authored posture placeholder; live Money Ledger reading required

metrics.label: AI cost · 30 days
metrics.description: Provider-reported inference cost for the trailing thirty days.
metrics.whatIsNeeded: Production revenue-summary promotion evidence for provider-reported AI cost.

sample.basis: hand-authored scenario for provider cost in micro-USD, reviewed 2026-09-16

metrics.label: Credit margin · 30 days
metrics.description: Credit top-up revenue less provider-reported inference cost, calculated at read time.
metrics.whatIsNeeded: Production revenue-summary promotion evidence for credit revenue and provider cost.

sample.basis: read-time credit top-up revenue minus provider cost, reviewed 2026-09-16
